question: $13.$ 设可微函数 $f(x,y)$ 满足 $(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x})^2+(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y})^2=\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}$，若极坐标系下 $f(x,y)$ 可表示为 $z(r,\theta)$，则 $r^2(\frac{\partial z}{\partial r})^2+(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta})^2=\underline{\qquad\qquad}$
raw_question_text: $13.$ 设可微函数 $f(x,y)$ 满足 $(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x})^2+(\frac{\partial f}{\partial y})^2=\frac{1}{x^2+y^2}$，若极坐标系下 $f(x,y)$ 可表示为 $z(r,\theta)$，则 $r^2(\frac{\partial z}{\partial r})^2+(\frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta})^2=\underline{\qquad\qquad}$
